title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00053 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:00: Installed lifting sub, p/u string and set slips on casing. Released spear from fish. Inspected spear grapple. No signs of impact on grapple observed. Grapple in good condition
01:00 - 01:30: Installed c-plate and additional BX-ELEVATOR as false rotary on top of casing stump. Set of weight of string in BX-ELEVATOR and broke connection above. L/d spear assembly on HTS
01:30 - 01:45: Performed pre-job meeting to rearrange BHA
01:45 - 03:30: Rearanged spear BHA in foxhole to include 1x string stab od) above the spear grapple
03:30 - 04:00: P/u spear assembly and m/u to DP in well center engaged spear to 10 3/4in CSG fish
04:00 - 05:00: RIH w/ 10 3/4in CSG fish on spear. Released spear from the fish
05:00 - 06:30: Attempted to pull spear several times. MAX overpull of 10t, with and without torque. No success
06:30 - 09:45: Engaged fish on spear. Evaluated situation. Discussed way forward. Reviewed BHA/WELL schematic and concluded that it was not grapple that hung off, but taper mill hung off. Meanwhile cleared rig floor, serviced drilling equipment, removed scaffold from forward RPS
09:45 - 10:30: Released fish. Pulled gradually to 170t weight on hook overpull). Observed drop on hook load to 103t indicating string free.
10:30 - 11:30: POOH w/ BHA#27 on 5,5in DP from 910 m to 789m.
11:30 - 13:00: Removed xover and pup above drill collar. Installed bumper sub. Inspected, cleaned and serviced grapple. Broke out xover below spear and installed ball sub.
13:00 - 13:30: R/b spear assy, l/d pup joints, p/u single
13:30 - 13:45: Installed PS 21
13:45 - 14:45: POOH from 741m w/ cutter using mud bucked to 16m
14:45 - 15:00: Removed PS 21 and installed master bushing
15:00 - 16:00: POOH w/ cutter assy. L/d same. Inspected cutter. Signes of wear on the knives. Piece of taper mill missing of 2-3cm)
16:00 - 16:30: Cleared and cleaned rig floor
16:30 - 16:45: P/u and m/u spear BHA Inspected and serviced grapple
16:45 - 17:00: RIH w/ spear assy from 27m
